# Redacting a share link on the product tour

The share step of the product tour, held on one frame: for three seconds the report link is readable, then the masked version takes over and the link field is pixelated and blurred so the URL cannot be read.

- Type: Redaction
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `mask`
- Output: 1920x1080, 8 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/f21-redact.mp4`](../videos/f21-redact.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> The product tour ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 shows a live report link (hub.magnifito.demo/r/spring) in the Share report popover. Hold the frame at 15.75 s for 8 seconds and redact the link field with a blur mask (box 1340,336 to 1726,394). For the client, show the original frame for the first 3 seconds with an "Original frame" label, then cut to the redacted version labelled "Share link redacted", in Geist from fonts/.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f21-redact
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f21-redact/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 15.75 -i ../videos/02-product-demo.mp4 -frames:v 1 work/frame.png
ffmpeg -loop 1 -framerate 30 -t 8 -i work/frame.png -c:v libx264 -crf 14 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p work/still.mp4
mgvideo mask work/still.mp4 --box 1340,336,386,58 --mode blur --out work/redacted.mp4
node rasterize.mjs label-original.svg work/label-original.png 1920 1080
node rasterize.mjs label-redacted.svg work/label-redacted.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/still.mp4 -i work/redacted.mp4 -i work/label-original.png -i work/label-redacted.png -filter_complex "[0:v]trim=0:3,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a];[2:v]loop=-1:1,trim=0:3[la];[a][la]overlay=0:0[av];[1:v]trim=3:8,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[b];[3:v]loop=-1:1,trim=0:5[lb];[b][lb]overlay=0:0[bv];[av][bv]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/compare.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/compare.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
